scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/noteplan/commands.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=SortPriorityPlugin --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/script.js --footer:js="function sortCurrentNoteTasksByPriority(){return SortPriorityPlugin.sortCurrentNoteTasksByPriority()}" && cp plugin.json dist/plugin.json && cp README.smart-sort.md dist/README.md
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && rm -rf .test-dist && esbuild tests/core/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outdir=.test-dist/tests/core && cp -R tests/fixtures .test-dist/tests/fixtures && node --test .test-dist/tests/core/*.js
